title: A Postcards for the Blue Hour
author: Ada Nystrom
blurb: Jonah Montrose, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
